GRADE 5 SOCIAL STUDIES — TERM 3 EXAM

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: SOCIAL STUDIES
Time: 40 minutes

INSTRUCTIONS
1. Answer all questions.
2. Use neat handwriting.
2. For multiple choice, write the correct letter only.
3. For short answers, write clearly in the spaces provided.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A: Multiple Choice

1. About Wildlife and Tourism in Kenya Sites Sceneries in your school compound, which statement is correct?
   A. identify main tourist attractions in Kenya,
   B. Learners should ignore Wildlife and Tourism in Kenya Sites Sceneries completely.
   C. Wildlife and Tourism in Kenya Sites Sceneries is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Wildlife and Tourism in Kenya Sites Sceneries.

2. About Wildlife and Tourism in Kenya Sites Sceneries around your home, which statement is correct?
   A. locate main game reserves and national parks in Kenya,
   B. Learners should ignore Wildlife and Tourism in Kenya Sites Sceneries completely.
   C. Wildlife and Tourism in Kenya Sites Sceneries is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Wildlife and Tourism in Kenya Sites Sceneries.

3. About Wildlife and Tourism in Kenya Sites Sceneries in your county, which statement is correct?
   A. explain contributions of wildlife and tourism to the economy,
   B. Learners should ignore Wildlife and Tourism in Kenya Sites Sceneries completely.
   C. Wildlife and Tourism in Kenya Sites Sceneries is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Wildlife and Tourism in Kenya Sites Sceneries.

5. About Development of Transport in your school compound, which statement is correct?
   A. outline main means of early transport to facilitate movement of goods and services,
   B. Learners should ignore Development of Transport completely.
   C. Development of Transport is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Development of Transport.

6. About Development of Transport around your home, which statement is correct?
   A. identify modern means of transport in Kenya,
   B. Learners should ignore Development of Transport completely.
   C. Development of Transport is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Development of Transport.

7. About Development of Transport in your county, which statement is correct?
   A. explore ways of maintaining road safety in society,
   B. Learners should ignore Development of Transport completely.
   C. Development of Transport is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Development of Transport.

9. About Development of Communication Traditional forms: smoke signals Modern forms phone in your school compound, which statement is correct?
   A. outline main early forms of communication to facilitate social interactions,
   B. Learners should ignore Development of Communication Traditional forms: smoke signals Modern forms phone completely.
   C. Development of Communication Traditional forms: smoke signals Modern forms phone is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Development of Communication Traditional forms: smoke signals Modern forms phone.

10. About Development of Communication Traditional forms: smoke signals Modern forms phone around your home, which statement is correct?
   A. explore modern means of communication in Kenya,
   B. Learners should ignore Development of Communication Traditional forms: smoke signals Modern forms phone completely.
   C. Development of Communication Traditional forms: smoke signals Modern forms phone is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Development of Communication Traditional forms: smoke signals Modern forms phone.

11. About Development of Communication Traditional forms: smoke signals Modern forms phone in your county, which statement is correct?
   A. illustrate modern means of communication used in their community,
   B. Learners should ignore Development of Communication Traditional forms: smoke signals Modern forms phone completely.
   C. Development of Communication Traditional forms: smoke signals Modern forms phone is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Development of Communication Traditional forms: smoke signals Modern forms phone.

13. About Early forms of Governm ent in Kenya in your school compound, which statement is correct?
   A. describe early forms of government among selected communities in Kenya,
   B. Learners should ignore Early forms of Governm ent in Kenya completely.
   C. Early forms of Governm ent in Kenya is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Early forms of Governm ent in Kenya.

14. About Early forms of Governm ent in Kenya around your home, which statement is correct?
   A. compare early forms of government of the Maasai and Ameru,
   B. Learners should ignore Early forms of Governm ent in Kenya completely.
   C. Early forms of Governm ent in Kenya is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Early forms of Governm ent in Kenya.

15. About Early forms of Governm ent in Kenya in your county, which statement is correct?
   A. apply best practices from early forms of government among selected communities in Kenya to modern governance,
   B. Learners should ignore Early forms of Governm ent in Kenya completely.
   C. Early forms of Governm ent in Kenya is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Early forms of Governm ent in Kenya.

17. About Citizenship in Kenya in your school compound, which statement is correct?
   A. state how one becomes a citizen in Kenya,
   B. Learners should ignore Citizenship in Kenya completely.
   C. Citizenship in Kenya is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Citizenship in Kenya.

18. About Citizenship in Kenya around your home, which statement is correct?
   A. explain requirements for dual citizenship in Kenya,
   B. Learners should ignore Citizenship in Kenya completely.
   C. Citizenship in Kenya is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Citizenship in Kenya.

19. About Citizenship in Kenya in your county, which statement is correct?
   A. demonstrate good citizenship for personal and social well-being,
   B. Learners should ignore Citizenship in Kenya completely.
   C. Citizenship in Kenya is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Citizenship in Kenya.

SECTION B: Short Answers
